title: SemgrepScanScope
description: The effective scan scope of one required Semgrep run (`l9-ci semgrep run --required`), written beside the raw report as <stem>.scope.json. A factual record of what was scanned and why; it carries no verdict.

policy.description: The SDK-packaged scan-scope policy that decided the scope.

source.description: Where candidate files come from: files tracked at the analyzed snapshot.

nosem.description: Inline `nosemgrep` comments do not suppress findings in a required run.

analysis_budget.description: Per-rule, per-file Semgrep analysis budget of the required run. A rule/file pair that exceeds it is not analysed and counts as incomplete coverage, never as a pass.

timeout_threshold.description: Semgrep --timeout-threshold; 0 disables skipping the remaining rules on a file after repeated timeouts.

files.description: Tracked .semgrepignore files present in the repository.

in_scope_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the newline-joined, ordered list of in-scope paths.

excluded.description: Tracked files left out of scope, grouped by the policy entry (or not-a-regular-file) that excluded them.

reason.description: The policy's declared reason for this exclusion, when it declares one.
